{{Quote|They're shipping me off to Vizcarra.''"<br />"''The Imperial prison planet?''"<br />"''Yep. And here I sit, picking my nose hairs, with half of my crew docked across the street, waiting for me.|Tait Ransom and Karl Mathieu Ancher|<ref name="Journal3" />}}
'''Vizcarra''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]]. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Syychi]], who went on to be [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the Empire, was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] there, and at one point she and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Memcha-Badawzi]]&mdash;who was sentenced to [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisonment]] on Vizcarra&mdash;both escaped from an [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveling to the planet. Similarly, in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] the smuggler [[Tait Ransom]] also escaped from detention on the planet [[Omman Minor]] before he could be shipped off to Vizcarra.

==Description==
Vizcarra was a terrestrial<ref name="Socorro" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal3" /> located in the [[Vizcarra system/Legends|Vizcarra system]], a part of the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it served as an Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world.<ref name="Journal3" />

==History==
[[File:Syychi.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Wookiee Syychi was born on Vizcarra.]]
At some point, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Syychi]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Vizcarra, becoming subjected since birth to Imperial exploitation and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]].<ref name="Socorro" /> Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="2 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|3|When the Domino Falls}} to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> Imperial authorities on [[Omman Minor]], a planet<ref name="Journal3" /> in the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]],<ref name="EAOC Omman">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Omman Minor system/Legends|Omman Minor system]]</ref> arrested the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tait Ransom]] for illegal handling of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. In 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] Ransom was held in the holding cells of Omman Minor's [[Bureau of Customs]], where he informed his fellow detainees [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]], [[Drake Paulsen]], and [[Nikaede Celso]] that he was scheduled to be shipped off to Vizcarra. However, the quartet subsequently broke out of the cell and escaped the planet.<ref name="Journal3" />

The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] smuggler [[Memcha-Badawzi]] was at one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] sentenced to imprisonment on Vizcarra for smuggling [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and being suspected of collaborating with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She was sent on a long trip to Vizcarra aboard an [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on which Syychi was also present. The pair, aided by other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], eventually managed to overpower the ship's crew and escape.<ref name="Socorro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vizcarra was first mentioned in the short story "[[When the Domino Falls]]," which was written by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] and published in the [[August]] [[1994]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|third issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal3" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vizcarra [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square L-20.<ref name="TEA" />
